'''Jun Hokan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and a comrade of [[Munin Skirata]]. He questioned whether Skirata was being too aggressive in training [[Kal Skirata|Falin]], a young orphan that Munin took under his wing while they were on a job on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mes Cavoli]]<ref name="o66" />

He had a [[Jun Hokan's son|son]] though it is not known whether or not he is related to [[Ghez Hokan]].<ref name="o66" />
